features.name: Brookside Gardens
features.description: A free 50-acre public display garden within Wheaton Regional Park, with themed gardens, two conservatories, a Visitor Center, accessible paths, seasonal flowers, water features, and quiet walking routes.

features.name: Brookside Nature Center & Harper Homestead
features.description: A wooded nature center area with weekend exhibits, local animal ambassadors, nature play, pond and interpretive routes, and the relocated 1870s Harper family homestead.
